papers.title: Quantification of airfoil geometry-induced aerodynamic uncertainties - comparison of approaches
papers.abstract: Uncertainty quantification in aerodynamic simulations calls for efficient numerical methods since it is computationally expensive, especially for the uncertainties caused by random geometry variations which involve a large number of variables. This paper compares five methods, including quasi-Monte Carlo quadrature, polynomial chaos with coefficients determined by sparse quadrature and gradient-enhanced version of Kriging, radial basis functions and point collocation polynomial chaos, in their efficiency in estimating statistics of aerodynamic performance upon random perturbation to the airfoil geometry which is parameterized by 9 independent Gaussian variables. The results show that gradient-enhanced surrogate methods achieve better accuracy than direct integration methods with the same computational cost.

llm.relevance_to_user: 虽然面向气动领域，但其不确定性量化和代理模型方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计。
llm.why_not_core: No biomechanical or implant design context, no FEA surrogate specifically for biomedical applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较五种方法在气动几何不确定性量化中的效率。
summary_zh.method: 对比准蒙特卡罗、多项式混沌、梯度增强Kriging、径向基函数和点配置多项式混沌。
summary_zh.result: 梯度增强代理方法在相同计算成本下精度更优。
summary_zh.validation: 基于9维高斯随机变量的翼型气动性能数值实验。

summary_en.motivation: Efficient uncertainty quantification in aerodynamic simulations is challenging due to high computational cost, especially for geometry-induced uncertainties with many variables.
summary_en.method: Five methods including quasi-Monte Carlo, polynomial chaos with sparse quadrature, gradient-enhanced Kriging, radial basis functions, and point collocation polynomial chaos are compared for estimating aerodynamic statistics under random airfoil geometry perturbations.
summary_en.result: Gradient-enhanced surrogate methods achieve better accuracy than direct integration methods at the same computational cost.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmark on an airfoil parameterized by 9 independent Gaussian variables.

papers.title: Pivoted Cholesky decomposition by Cross Approximation for efficient solution of kernel systems
papers.abstract: Large kernel systems are prone to be ill-conditioned. Pivoted Cholesky decomposition (PCD) render a stable and efficient solution to the systems without a perturbation of regularization. This paper proposes a new PCD algorithm by tuning Cross Approximation (CA) algorithm to kernel matrices which merges the merits of PCD and CA, and proves as well as numerically exemplifies that it solves large kernel systems two-order more efficiently than those resorts to regularization. As a by-product, a diagonal-pivoted CA technique is also shown efficient in eigen-decomposition of large covariance matrices in an uncertainty quantification problem.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提供了一种高效的核系统求解方法，但与FEA代理建模或生物力学设计无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on efficient linear algebra for kernel systems, without addressing FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or biomechanics application.

summary_zh.motivation: 大型核系统求解效率低且易病态
summary_zh.method: 提出基于交叉逼近的枢轴Cholesky分解算法
summary_zh.result: 相比正则化方法效率提升两个数量级
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值算例验证算法性能和稳定性

summary_en.motivation: Efficient and stable solution of large ill-conditioned kernel systems is needed.
summary_en.method: A new pivoted Cholesky decomposition algorithm is proposed by integrating cross approximation for kernel matrices.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves two-order-of-magnitude efficiency improvement over regularization-based approaches.
summary_en.validation: Numerical examples demonstrate the efficiency and stability of the algorithm.

papers.title: Effect of heat treatment on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Inconel 718 processed by selective laser melting

corresponding_authors.name: Edward Chlebus
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Centre for Advanced Manufacturing Technologies/Fraunhofer Project Center, Faculty of Mechanical Engineering, Wrocław University of Technology, ul. Łukasiewicza 5, 55-371 Wrocław, Poland

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究非生物医用合金的工艺参数，与生物医用植入物的应力遮挡和骨整合无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on Inconel 718 for non-biomedical applications and lacks any discussion of porous structures, stress shielding, osseointegration, or biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究热处理对选区激光熔化Inconel 718合金微观结构和力学性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 通过实验表征不同热处理条件下的微观组织和拉伸性能
summary_zh.result: 发现了热处理制度对强度与塑性的显著影响规律
summary_zh.validation: 利用微观组织观察和力学测试验证结果

summary_en.motivation: This study investigates the effect of heat treatment on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Inconel 718 fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Experimental characterization was performed on samples subjected to various heat treatment cycles, including microstructure analysis and tensile testing.
summary_en.result: The results reveal a significant influence of heat treatment parameters on the strength-ductility trade-off in SLM-processed Inconel 718.
summary_en.validation: Validation was conducted through microstructural observation and mechanical testing.
